title: Davis Vantage Reading Weekly Solar Radiation Trend
dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`, `airgradient:sensor`), soil-moisture/greenhouse sensors, aquarium controllers (`aquarium:sensor`).
app: Personal weather stations (Ecowitt/Ambient/Davis/WeatherFlow), air-quality sensors (PurpleAir/AirGradient), and aquarium/greenhouse/soil sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=davis:vantage solar_wm2=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(solar_wm2) as avg_duration, max(solar_wm2) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst solar radiation for Davis Vantage reading events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture solar_wm2 on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average solar radiation with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It rates whether Davis Vantage reading tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
